why: PT477 supplies no modern calendrical interval linking Sirius guidance to a future physical event.
The 8.6009-year number is an astronomical light-travel interval, not a ritual or deity-return interval.
No evidence binds the user-selected 2026 anchor to an emission event carrying information about Osiris or a relic.
The 𓂸 marker is a JANUS protocol delimiter, not evidence that the PT477 Sirius passage refers to the missing member.
